title: Watch Cops Seize Combat Vet's Life Savings [RARE FOOTAGE]
summary: Institute for Justice footage of Nevada Highway Patrol troopers seizing the life savings of Stephen Lara, a retired Marine, during a traffic stop under civil forfeiture. The video documents the stop and the case that followed.
why: HN commenters cite it as a concrete example of police seizing cash from innocent people on flimsy pretexts.
